concerns.text: FR-005 mandates a Wilcoxon signed-rank test. SC-003 requires measuring significance against p < 0.05 using Wilcoxon. While T027 implements Wilcoxon, T031 (Report Generation) and T024 (Aggregation) are marked [ ] (incomplete). The final report generation task (T031) is missing, leaving no task to actually output the Wilcoxon p-value and significance statement required by FR-005 and SC-003.

SC-004 requires measuring robustness via 'variance in false-positive rates' across sensitivity thresholds. T032a and T032b are marked [ ] (incomplete). Without these tasks, there is no implementation path to calculate the false-positive rate (blocks selected by heuristic but not baseline) required to satisfy SC-004.

FR-003 and FR-007 mandate strict memory handling (exit code 1 if >7GB). T043 (Loader Refactor), T044 (Streaming Chunker), T045 (Data Verification), and T046 (Representativeness Check) are marked [ ] (incomplete). These tasks are critical for satisfying the 'Data Hygiene' and 'Memory Constraint' requirements of the spec, yet no implementation tasks exist for them.

The Plan (Project Structure) requires `code/`, `data/raw`, `data/processed`, `results`, `tests/unit`, `tests/integration` directories. T001a (Create directories) is marked [ ] (incomplete). Without this task, the foundational infrastructure required for all other tasks is missing.

The Plan requires `requirements.txt` with specific dependencies. T003 (Configure linting/formatting) is marked [ ] (incomplete). While T002 initializes the project, T003 is needed to enforce the 'Reproducibility' and 'Versioning' principles of the Constitution via linting/formatting tools.

T027 and T027b contain contradictory instructions regarding statistical priority. T027 states 'PRIMARY Wilcoxon... SECONDARY Paired t-test', while T027b states 'Wilcoxon as primary... Paired t-test as secondary'. However, the Plan explicitly states 'Paired t-test is primary per Constitution'. The tasks do not clearly resolve this conflict, potentially leading to an implementation that violates the Constitution (Principle VII) or the Spec (FR-005).
